pages.name: tabs
pages.after: (() => { const n = document.querySelector('nav[aria-label]'); const f = document.querySelector('form[role=search]'); return { navW: n.clientWidth, navSW: n.scrollWidth, formW: f.clientWidth, links: [...n.querySelectorAll('a')].map(a => a.textContent.trim() + ':' + Math.round(a.getBoundingClientRect().right)) }; })()
